<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Account Performance Dashboard</title>
<!-- APD-TEMPLATE schema=2 · build 2026-08-26b: calendar-anchored period cohorts + cache freshness guard · period-aware campaigns + live-artifact loader. This is the ONE canonical
     template. If THIS marker or the APD-TEMPLATE-END sentinel at end-of-file is missing, the copy on
     disk is stale or truncated — STOP; do NOT substitute an older/production template or hand-build. -->
<!-- Live-artifact seed + cache loader (runs before the main script reads __APD__).
     The seed blob is injected ONCE at the /*__DATA__*/ marker below by the skill at
     build time. On first open the seed is written to localStorage; thereafter the
     cached blob (which the in-page refresh pipeline tail-updates) wins. __APD_LSKEY__
     is stamped per store at build time and MUST match refresh-pipeline's APD_CFG.key. -->
<script>
window.__APD_SEED__ = /*__DATA__*/{};
(function(){
 var K='__APD_LSKEY__';   // apd_<store>_vN — BUMP N on ANY blob-shape change (see meta.schema)
 var seed=window.__APD_SEED__||{};
 // Shape/version guard: drop a cached blob that predates a schema change so a stale
 // cache can never feed a mismatched shape into the template (the empty-CAMP-table bug).
 function okShape(b){
   if(!b||!b.meta) return false;
   if((b.meta.schema||0)!==(seed.meta&&seed.meta.schema||0)) return false;   // schema version must match the seed
   if(Array.isArray(b.CAMP)&&b.CAMP.length){                                 // CAMP must be object-per-campaign monthly series…
     var c=b.CAMP[0]; if(!c||Array.isArray(c)||!Array.isArray(c.spend)) return false;   // …not the old flat [name,type,…] array
   }
   // Freshness guard (added 2026-08-26b): a REBUILD ships a newer seed, but the cache
   // wins on shape alone — so a viewer who opened the previous build kept seeing its
   // data forever in snapshot mode. Drop any cache generated before this seed. The
   // pipeline stamps meta.generatedAt on every tail-refresh, so a legitimately
   // refreshed cache is always >= the seed and is still preserved.
   var cg=(b.meta.generatedAt||''), sg=(seed.meta&&seed.meta.generatedAt)||'';
   if(cg&&sg&&cg<sg) return false;
   return true;
 }
 var c=null;try{c=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K));}catch(e){}
 if(!okShape(c)){c=seed;try{localStorage.setItem(K,JSON.stringify(c));}catch(e){}}
 window.__APD_CACHE__=c;
})();
</script>

        meta: { brand, store, marketplace, dateRange, dateRangeUpper, dataThrough,
                generatedAt, window:{start,end,months},
                manifest: { store, marketplace_id, window, calls:[ {id,tool,args,note} ], refresh } },
        MO:   ['Dec 25', ...],                 // short month labels
        MF:   ['December 2025', ...],           // full month labels
        MMAP: {'YYYY-MM': monthIndex},
        M:    { rev:[],units:[],orders:[],ad:[],adSales:[],varFees:[],operating:[],lowInv:[],
                storage:[],fbaFul:[],promo:[],refunds:[],net:[],impr:[],clicks:[],
                sp:[],sb:[],sd:[],spSales:[],sbSales:[],sdSales:[] },   // each array length == MO
        PROD: [ {asin,name,short,emoji,sku,rev:[],units:[],ad:[],acos:[],fees:[]} ],
        DAILY:[ [date,rev,units,orders,fees,ad,refunds] ],
        CAMP: [ {name,type,status,spend:[],sales:[],orders:[],impr:[],clicks:[]} ], // per-campaign monthly series, arrays aligned to MO
        COGS: [ per-unit cost in PROD order ],
        SNS:  { available, marketplace, active:[], units:[], rev:[], oos:[], discount:[],
                lift:{ratio,subAvg,nonSubAvg,window} }   // Subscribe & Save; arrays month-aligned to MO
      }
    meta.manifest is the REFRESH CONTRACT — the Sophie Hub MCP calls (store + window) that
    produce the blob. In Cowork the artifact re-runs them on open; elsewhere it is a snapshot.
    The header, date pill, SnS subtitle/badge, brand filter and footer are all driven from
    meta at runtime (applyMeta), so a refresh updates them too — there are NO {{...}} text
    placeholders to substitute.

  Everything else in this file - CSS, layout, charts, filters, tabs, tables,
  helper functions - must be preserved verbatim so every store renders an
  identical-looking dashboard.

</script>
<style>
:root{
 --bg:#F3F3F1;--card:#FFFFFF;--text:#212121;--muted:#666666;--border:#E6E6E6;
 --green:#13835B;--amber:#EA6C34;--red:#C8184A;--navy:#0A2333;--blue:#0A2333;--purple:#7B2D8B;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.01em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.mono{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace}
/* ---------- HEADER ---------- */
.hdr{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;height:68px;background:var(--navy);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 36px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(10,35,51,.18)}
.hdr-l{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.hdr-l .nm{color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.hdr-div{width:1px;height:26px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent)}
.hdr-l .sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.6px}
.hdr-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.datepill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 11px;color:#fff;font-size:11.5px}
/* ---------- FILTER BAR ---------- */
.filterbar{position:sticky;top:68px;z-index:150;background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 36px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.filt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.filt > label{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.4px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.filt select,.filt input[type=date]{font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;padding:7px 9px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:var(--card);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.filt select:focus,.filt input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green)}
.fdiv{width:1px;height:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,var(--border),transparent)}
.gran{display:inline-flex;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.gran button{font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:7px 13px;background:var(--card);border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted)}
.gran button.active{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.gran button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.msel{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.mselbtn{font:inherit;font-size:12px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d9dee5);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;min-width:150px;text-align:left}
.mselpanel{display:none;position:absolute;z-index:60;top:calc(100% + 4px);left:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line,#d9dee5);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.14);padding:6px;max-height:320px;overflow:auto;min-width:250px}
.mselpanel.open{display:block}
.msrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.msrow:hover{background:#f1f5f9}
.msrow.msall{border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f4;margin-bottom:4px;padding-bottom:7px}
.msasin{color:var(--muted,#8a93a0);font-size:10px;margin-left:auto}
.customrange{display:none;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.customrange.show{display:flex}
.ctxchip{margin-left:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.ctxchip b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
/* ---------- TABS ---------- */
.tabnav{position:sticky;top:121px;z-index:140;background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 36px;display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto}
.tabnav button{font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:13px 14px 11px;background:none;border:none;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.tabnav button.active{color:var(--navy);border-bottom-color:var(--green)}
main{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px 36px 48px}
.tabpane{display:none}
.tabpane.active{display:block}
.tabpane > section{margin-bottom:28px}
/* section header */
.sechead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;margin-bottom:6px}
.sechead h2{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.sechead p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.datebadge{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);border-radius:7px;padding:5px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
/* KPI */
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
.kpis.k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
@media(max-width:900px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.kpi{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,35,51,.08);padding:18px 18px 20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(10,35,51,.12)}
.kpi::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:currentColor}
.kpi.green{color:var(--green)}.kpi.amber{color:var(--amber)}.kpi.red{color:var(--red)}
.kpi.navy{color:var(--navy)}.kpi.purple{color:var(--purple)}
.kpi .lbl{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.4px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.kpi .kpisel{font-family:inherit;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;border:none;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border);cursor:pointer;padding:0 15px 2px 0;margin:0;max-width:100%;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='9' height='9' viewBox='0 0 10 10'><path d='M1 3l4 4 4-4' fill='none' stroke='%23999' stroke-width='1.6'/></svg>");background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:right 1px center}
.kpi .kpisel:hover,.kpi .kpisel:focus{color:var(--navy);outline:none}
.kpi .val{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.6px;margin:8px 0 3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi .meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.kpi .delta{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:12px}
.kpi .delta.up{background:rgba(19,131,91,.12);color:var(--green)}
.kpi .delta.down{background:rgba(200,24,74,.12);color:var(--red)}
.kpi .delta.flat{background:rgba(102,102,102,.12);color:var(--muted)}
/* callouts */
.callouts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:900px){.callouts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.callout{border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid}
.callout .em{font-size:22px}
.callout .ct{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin:6px 0 4px}
.callout .cd{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45}
.callout.green{background:rgba(19,131,91,.09);border-color:rgba(19,131,91,.3);color:#0e5e42}
.callout.amber{background:rgba(234,108,52,.09);border-color:rgba(234,108,52,.3);color:#8a3f17}
.callout.navy{background:rgba(10,35,51,.06);border-color:rgba(10,35,51,.2);color:#0A2333}
.callout.red{background:rgba(200,24,74,.09);border-color:rgba(200,24,74,.3);color:#8a0f33}
/* chart cards */
.crow{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:0}
.crow.c2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.crow.c3{grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr}
@media(max-width:900px){.crow.c2,.crow.c3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,35,51,.08);padding:18px}
.card h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card h3 .ctx{font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
.card h3 .sp{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.card h3 select{font-family:inherit;font-size:11.5px;padding:4px 7px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:var(--card);cursor:pointer}
.chartbox{position:relative;height:280px;margin-top:14px}
.chartbox.h300{height:300px}.chartbox.h260{height:260px}.chartbox.h240{height:240px}
.cardsub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
/* tables */
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto;margin-top:14px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}
thead th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;text-align:right;padding:9px 11px;white-space:nowrap}
thead th:first-child{text-align:left}
tbody td{text-align:right;padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap}
tbody td:first-child{text-align:left;font-weight:600}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg)}
.pill{display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.pill.g{background:rgba(19,131,91,.12);color:var(--green)}
.pill.o{background:rgba(234,108,52,.12);color:var(--amber)}
.pill.r{background:rgba(200,24,74,.12);color:var(--red)}
.pill.navy{background:rgba(10,35,51,.1);color:var(--navy)}
.pill.purple{background:rgba(123,45,139,.12);color:var(--purple)}
.up{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}.down{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
/* product cards */
.prodgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:1200px){.prodgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:900px){.prodgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.prodgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.pcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,35,51,.08);padding:15px;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(10,35,51,.12)}
.pcard .ptop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.pcard .pn{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3}
.pcard .pa{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.pcard .pa a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:none}
.pstats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.pstat{background:var(--bg);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 9px}
.pstat .k{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.pstat .v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-top:1px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* cogs editor */
.cogsgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
@media(max-width:900px){.cogsgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.cogsgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.cogstile{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 13px}
.cogstile .cn{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.cogstile .ca{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 7px}
.cogstile .cv{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.cogstile input{font-family:inherit;width:84px;padding:5px 7px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;text-align:right;font-size:13px}
.btn{font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:7px;border:1.5px solid var(--navy);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--card);color:var(--navy)}
.btn.green{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.searchin{font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;padding:6px 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;min-width:170px}
/* P&L matrix */
.plmatrix td:first-child,.plmatrix th:first-child{position:sticky;left:0;background:var(--card);z-index:1}
.plmatrix thead th:first-child{background:var(--navy)}
.plmatrix tbody tr:hover td:first-child{background:var(--bg)}
.plmatrix .exprow{cursor:pointer}
.plmatrix .arr{display:inline-block;width:13px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .15s}
.plmatrix .arr.open{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.plmatrix .childrow td{color:var(--muted);background:rgba(243,243,241,.5)}
.plmatrix .childrow td:first-child{padding-left:30px;font-weight:500;background:rgba(243,243,241,.9)}
.plmatrix .secrow td{background:var(--bg);font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);border-top:2px solid var(--border)}
.plmatrix tr.bold td{font-weight:700;background:rgba(243,243,241,.6)}
.plmatrix tr.bold td:first-child{background:rgba(243,243,241,.95)}
.note{background:rgba(234,108,52,.09);border:1px solid rgba(234,108,52,.3);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:12.5px;color:#7a3a18}
.notice{background:rgba(19,131,91,.08);border:1px solid rgba(19,131,91,.3);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:12.5px;color:#0e5e42;margin-bottom:16px}
.underconstruction{background:rgba(234,108,52,.12);border:1px solid rgba(234,108,52,.4);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 16px;font-size:13px;color:#7a3a18;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.underconstruction .uc-em{font-size:18px;line-height:1.2}
.underconstruction b{color:#8a3f17}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:30px 18px;color:var(--muted)}
.empty .big{font-size:34px;margin-bottom:8px}
.snapgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
@media(max-width:700px){.snapgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.snapbox{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:12px;text-align:center}
.snapbox .sv{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.snapbox .sk{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-top:3px}
/* ---------- P&L period tiles (Sellerboard-style) ---------- */
.pftiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.pftiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:680px){.pftiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.pftile{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,35,51,.08);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.pftile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(10,35,51,.12)}
.pftile .hd{padding:10px 13px;color:#fff}
.pftile .hd .t{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.2px}
.pftile .hd .d{font-size:10.5px;opacity:.85;margin-top:1px}
.pftile .bd{padding:12px 13px}
.pftile .sv{font-size:21px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pftile .sl{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.pftile .gr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px 10px;margin-top:11px}
.pftile .gr .v{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pftile .np{margin-top:11px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.pftile .np .v{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.pftile .dlt{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-left:6px}
.pftile .dlt.up{color:var(--green)}.pftile .dlt.down{color:var(--red)}.pftile .dlt.flat{color:var(--muted)}
.pfctl{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.pfctl label{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.pfctl select{font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:var(--card);cursor:pointer}
/* ---------- P&L chart + breakdown split ---------- */
.plsplit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:20px;align-items:start}
@media(max-width:900px){.plsplit{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.plbd{font-size:12.5px}
@media(max-width:900px){.plbd{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:12px}}
.plbd .r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border)}
.plbd .r .k{color:var(--text)}
.plbd .r .v{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600}
.plbd .r.neg .v{color:var(--red)}
.plbd .r.bold{font-weight:700;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border)}
.plbd .r.bold .k{font-weight:700}
.plbd .r.sec{font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;border:none;padding:11px 0 2px}
.plbd .r.muted .v{color:var(--muted)}
.sbsdinfo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:help;font-style:normal}
</style>
</head>

It is an ESTIMATE (allocated by sales share), not Amazon attribution; ACOS stays SP-exact. See the note under the cards / P&L Matrix for details.">i</span>

   <div class="kpi amber"><select class="kpisel" data-ci="4" title="Choose metric"></select><div class="val" id="ovVal4">—</div><div class="meta" id="ovMeta4">—</div><div id="ovDelta4"></div></div>

 <section><div class="sechead">

 grossSales:[],gunits:[]},__APD__.M||{});

let MMAP=__APD__.MMAP||{};  // {'YYYY-MM': index} aligned with MO (rebuilt when months are added)
const BASEMAP=Object.assign({}, __APD__.MMAP||{});                 // pulled key→index (never changes)
const MO_BASE_KEYS=Object.keys(BASEMAP).sort((a,b)=>BASEMAP[a]-BASEMAP[b]);
const monIndexOf=ds=>MMAP[ds.slice(0,7)];

Chart.defaults.font.family='Inter';Chart.defaults.font.size=12;Chart.defaults.font.weight='500';

const MFIELDS=[{k:'sales',label:'Sales',apply:['rev','grossSales'],money:1},{k:'units',label:'Units',apply:['units','gunits'],money:0},
 {k:'ad',label:'Ad spend',apply:['ad'],money:1},{k:'varFees',label:'Referral',apply:['varFees'],money:1},{k:'fbaFul',label:'FBA',apply:['fbaFul'],money:1},
 {k:'operating',label:'Other',apply:['operating'],money:1},{k:'storage',label:'Storage',apply:['storage'],money:1},{k:'promo',label:'Promo',apply:['promo'],money:1},{k:'refunds',label:'Refunds',apply:['refunds'],money:1}];
const MONTHNAMES=['january','february','march','april','may','june','july','august','september','october','november','december'];
function monthKeyLabels(mk){const [y,m]=mk.split('-').map(Number);return {full:MONTHNAMES[m-1].replace(/^./,c=>c.toUpperCase())+' '+y, short:MONTHNAMES[m-1].slice(0,3).replace(/^./,c=>c.toUpperCase())+' '+String(y).slice(2)};}

function rebuildData(){
 const set=new Set(MO_BASE_KEYS); ADDEDMONTHS.forEach(k=>set.add(k)); Object.keys(OVR).forEach(k=>set.add(k));
 const keys=[...set].sort();

 MMAP={}; IDX2YM={}; keys.forEach((k,i)=>{MMAP[k]=i;IDX2YM[i]=k;});

 PROD.forEach((p,pi)=>{const bp=PROD_BASE[pi];if(!bp)return;['rev','units','ad','acos','fees','grev','sunits','sfees'].forEach(f=>{if(Array.isArray(bp[f]))p[f]=keys.map(k=>at(bp[f],k));});});

 Object.keys(OVR).forEach(mk=>{const i=MMAP[mk];if(i==null)return;const row=OVR[mk];
   MFIELDS.forEach(f=>{const v=row[f.k];if(v!=null&&!isNaN(v))f.apply.forEach(a=>{if(M[a])M[a][i]=+v;});});});

function commonPrefixWords(arr){if(!arr.length)return '';const sp=arr.map(s=>String(s).split(/\s+/));let out=[];for(let i=0;i<sp[0].length;i++){const w=sp[0][i];if(sp.every(s=>s[i]===w))out.push(w);else break;}return out.join(' ').trim();}

 if(Array.isArray(__APD__.PARENTS)&&__APD__.PARENTS.length)return __APD__.PARENTS;
 const g={},order=[];
 (PROD||[]).forEach(p=>{let key=String(p.sku||p.asin||'').toUpperCase().replace(/[-_ ]?\d.*$/,'');if(!key)key=p.asin;

/* monthly base (account or product) */
function monthlyBase(){
 if(isAll()){
   return MO.map((_,i)=>({rev:M.rev[i],units:M.units[i],orders:M.orders[i],ad:M.ad[i],adSales:M.adSales[i],
     fees:M.varFees[i]+M.operating[i]+M.fbaFul[i]+M.storage[i]+M.lowInv[i],promo:M.promo[i],refunds:M.refunds[i],impr:M.impr[i],clicks:M.clicks[i],
     sp:M.sp[i],sb:M.sb[i],sd:M.sd[i],spS:M.spSales[i],sbS:M.sbSales[i],sdS:M.sdSales[i]}));
 }
 const ps=selProds();
 return MO.map((_,i)=>{

   ps.forEach(p=>{rev+=p.rev[i];units+=p.units[i];ad+=p.ad[i];fees+=p.fees[i];adSales+=(p.acos[i]>0?p.ad[i]/p.acos[i]*100:0);});

function cogsMonthPF(i){

/* daily rows for the current selection. All Products → real account DAILY. A product subset has no per-day

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PERIOD COHORTS — calendar-anchored (fixed 2026-08-26).
   Previously every cohort was defined by POSITION in the loaded month array, so
   "This Month (MTD)" meant "the last month we happen to have" and drifted from
   the calendar as a snapshot aged (a 24-Aug build opened in October still read
   "August 2026 (MTD)"). Cohorts are now resolved on the real calendar and then
   INTERSECTED with the loaded data; when a cohort has no data the dashboard says
   so instead of silently substituting the latest month.
   Lifetime and Custom stay index-based over the loaded axis (unchanged).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function nowYMD(){const d=new Date();const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate());}
function ymAdd(ym,n){let y=+ym.slice(0,4),m=+ym.slice(5,7)+n;
  y+=Math.floor((m-1)/12);m=((m-1)%12+12)%12+1;return y+'-'+String(m).padStart(2,'0');}
/* The calendar range a cohort means, independent of what data we hold. */
function calRange(P,refYM){
  if(P==='mtd')      return[refYM,refYM];
  if(P==='lastmonth'){const p=ymAdd(refYM,-1);return[p,p];}
  if(P==='last3')     return[ymAdd(refYM,-2),refYM];
  if(P==='quarter'){const y=refYM.slice(0,4),q=Math.ceil((+refYM.slice(5,7))/3);
    return[y+'-'+String((q-1)*3+1).padStart(2,'0'),refYM];}
  if(P==='ytd')       return[refYM.slice(0,4)+'-01',refYM];
  return null;
}
function refYM(){return nowYMD().slice(0,7);}
/* Intersect a calendar YM range with the loaded axis. [-1,-1] = no overlap. */
function ymRangeToIdx(a,b){
  let lo=-1,hi=-1;
  for(let i=0;i<MO.length;i++){const ym=IDX2YM[i];if(!ym)continue;
    if(ym>=a&&ym<=b){if(lo<0)lo=i;hi=i;}}
  return[lo,hi];
}
function periodBounds(){
  const last=MO.length-1;
  if(PERIOD==='custom'){let a=+$('fFrom').value,b=+$('fTo').value;return a<=b?[a,b]:[b,a];}
  const cr=calRange(PERIOD,refYM());
  if(cr){const[lo,hi]=ymRangeToIdx(cr[0],cr[1]);return[lo,hi];}
  return[0,last<0?0:last];                       // lifetime
}
/* true when the selected cohort resolves to no loaded months at all */
function periodEmpty(){const[lo,hi]=periodBounds();return lo<0||hi<0;}
/* Human note when the cohort is empty or only partly covered by the data. */
function periodCoverageNote(){
  const cr=calRange(PERIOD,refYM());if(!cr)return'';
  const dt=(META&&META.dataThrough)||'';
  const[lo,hi]=ymRangeToIdx(cr[0],cr[1]);
  if(lo<0)return'this dashboard covers '+(MO[0]||'')+' — '+(MO[MO.length-1]||'')+
      (dt?(', data through '+dt):'')+'.';
  const wantEnd=cr[1],haveEnd=IDX2YM[hi]||'';
  if(haveEnd<wantEnd)return'Partial: data ends '+(MF[hi]||haveEnd)+(dt?(' ('+dt+')'):'')+'.';
  return'';
}
function applyPeriod(rows){const[lo,hi]=periodBounds();if(PERIOD==='lifetime')return rows;
  if(lo<0)return[];return rows.filter(r=>r.mi>=lo&&r.mi<=hi);}
function curRows(){return applyPeriod(FULL);}
function periodMonths(){if(!MO.length)return[];const[lo,hi]=periodBounds();
  if(lo<0||hi<0)return[];const a=[];for(let i=lo;i<=hi;i++)a.push(i);return a;}
function sum(rows,k){return rows.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b[k]||0),0);}
/* Labels name the CALENDAR period the user picked, not whatever months we hold. */
function ymFull(ym){if(!ym)return'';const MNS=['January','February','March','April','May','June',
  'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  return MNS[+ym.slice(5,7)-1]+' '+ym.slice(0,4);}
function ymShort(ym){if(!ym)return'';return ymFull(ym).slice(0,3)+' '+ym.slice(2,4);}
function periodLabel(){
  const last=MF.length-1;
  if(PERIOD==='lifetime')return MO[0]?(MO[0]+' — '+MO[last]):'';
  if(PERIOD==='custom')return (MF[+$('fFrom').value]||'')+' — '+(MF[+$('fTo').value]||'');
  const cr=calRange(PERIOD,refYM());if(!cr)return'';
  if(PERIOD==='mtd')return ymFull(cr[0])+' (MTD)';
  if(PERIOD==='lastmonth')return ymFull(cr[0]);
  if(PERIOD==='quarter')return ymShort(cr[0])+' — '+ymShort(cr[1])+' (QTD)';
  if(PERIOD==='ytd')return ymFull(cr[0]).split(' ')[0]+' — '+ymFull(cr[1])+' (YTD)';

function prodLabel(){if(isAll())return 'All Products';const ps=selProds();return ps.length===1?ps[0].short:ps.length+' products';}

/* ===================== COMPARISON & SEASONALITY ENGINE ===================== */
let IDX2YM=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(MMAP).map(([k,v])=>[v,k]));
const daysInMonth=ym=>{if(!ym)return 30;const a=ym.split('-');return new Date(+a[0],+a[1],0).getDate();};
function acctDaily(){return DAILY.map(d=>{const mi=monIndexOf(d[0]);const mr=M.rev[mi]||0;
  return{date:d[0],mi,rev:d[1]||0,units:d[2]||0,ad:d[5]||0,adSales:mr>0?(M.adSales[mi]||0)*((d[1]||0)/mr):0};});}

function partialDays(i){return daysOfMonth(i).length;}
/* latest month is "partial" only if it has data but fewer days than the calendar month */
function isPartialLatest(i){const last=MO.length-1;return i===last&&partialDays(i)>0&&partialDays(i)<daysInMonth(IDX2YM[i]);}
function totalsMonths(lo,hi){const base=monthlyBase();const t={rev:0,units:0,orders:0,ad:0,adSales:0,fees:0,cogs:0,net:0};
  for(let i=lo;i<=hi;i++){if(i<0||i>=base.length)continue;const m=base[i],cg=cogsMonth(i);
    t.rev+=m.rev;t.units+=m.units;t.orders+=m.orders;t.ad+=m.ad;t.adSales+=m.adSales;t.fees+=m.fees;t.cogs+=cg;t.net+=m.rev-m.ad-m.fees-m.promo-cg;}return t;}
function totalsDays(rows){const t={rev:0,units:0,orders:0,ad:0,adSales:0,fees:0,cogs:0,net:0};
  rows.forEach(d=>{const mu=M.units[d.mi]||0,cgm=cogsMonth(d.mi),cg=mu>0?cgm*(d.units/mu):0;
    t.rev+=d.rev;t.units+=d.units;t.ad+=d.ad;t.adSales+=d.adSales;t.cogs+=cg;t.net+=d.rev-d.ad-cg;});return t;}
const CMP_SHORT={pop:'vs prev',yoy:'vs LY',wow:'vs last wk'};
/* genuine comparison for the CURRENT period; honest when no comparable data exists */
function getComparison(){
 if(COMPARE==='none')return{active:false};
 const b=periodBounds(),lo=b[0],hi=b[1],len=hi-lo+1,last=MO.length-1;
 if(COMPARE==='wow'){const ad=selDailyRows();
   if(ad.length<14)return{active:true,available:false,short:CMP_SHORT.wow,reason:'no prior week of data',label:'WoW'};
   return{active:true,available:true,dayMatched:true,short:CMP_SHORT.wow,label:'last 7 days vs prior 7',
     cur:totalsDays(ad.slice(-7)),prev:totalsDays(ad.slice(-14,-7))};}
 const offset=(COMPARE==='yoy')?12:len,clo=lo-offset,chi=hi-offset;
 if(chi<0)return{active:true,available:false,short:CMP_SHORT[COMPARE],
   reason:(COMPARE==='yoy'?'no data 12 months back':'no equal-length prior period'),label:(COMPARE==='yoy'?'year ago':'previous period')};
 const partial=isAll()&&hi===last&&isPartialLatest(hi);
 let cur,prev,dayMatched=false,note='';
 if(partial&&len===1){const N=partialDays(hi);
   cur=totalsDays(daysOfMonth(hi));prev=totalsDays(daysOfMonth(chi).slice(0,N));dayMatched=true;note='first '+N+' days';}
 else{cur=totalsMonths(lo,hi);prev=totalsMonths(clo,chi);if(partial)note='current month partial';}
 const lbl=(COMPARE==='yoy')?('vs '+(MF[clo]||'year ago')):(len===1?('vs '+(MF[clo]||'prev month')):('vs '+(MO[clo]||'')+'–'+(MO[chi]||'')));

function pctChange(c,p){return(p==null||p===0)?null:(c-p)/Math.abs(p)*100;}
/* KPI delta chip: blank if no comparison, honest "no data" if the period can't be compared */
function chip(el,curV,prevV,lowerBetter,cmp){const e=$(el);if(!e)return;
 if(!cmp||!cmp.active){e.innerHTML='';return;}
 if(!cmp.available){e.innerHTML='<span class="delta flat" title="'+cmp.reason+'">— '+cmp.reason+'</span>';return;}
 const pc=pctChange(curV,prevV);
 if(pc==null){e.innerHTML='<span class="delta flat">— no baseline</span>';return;}
 const flat=Math.abs(pc)<0.5,up=curV>=prevV,good=lowerBetter?!up:up,cls=flat?'flat':(good?'up':'down'),ar=flat?'▬':(up?'▲':'▼');

/* per-month overlay of the comparison period, aligned to the current month slots */
function cmpOverlay(rows,fn,cmp){if(!cmp||!cmp.available||cmp.offset==null)return null;

function manHeaderField(h){h=(h||'').toLowerCase();
 if(/sale|revenue|gross/.test(h))return 'sales';if(/unit/.test(h))return 'units';
 if(/\bad\b|ppc|spend|advert/.test(h))return 'ad';if(/referral|commission/.test(h))return 'varFees';
 if(/fba|fulfil/.test(h))return 'fbaFul';if(/other/.test(h))return 'operating';if(/storage/.test(h))return 'storage';
 if(/promo/.test(h))return 'promo';if(/refund/.test(h))return 'refunds';return null;}
/* parse any month token → 'YYYY-MM' (works for months NOT in the pull, so new months can be added) */
function manNormMonth(s){s=(s||'').trim();if(!s)return null;
 let m=s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})/);if(m)return m[1]+'-'+String(+m[2]).padStart(2,'0');
 m=s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/);if(m)return m[2]+'-'+String(+m[1]).padStart(2,'0');           // MM/YYYY
 const t=s.toLowerCase();
 m=t.match(/([a-z]{3,})[ \-\/]*'?(\d{2,4})/);                                                       // "Mar 26" / "March 2026" / "mar-2026"
 if(m){const mi=MONTHNAMES.findIndex(n=>n.startsWith(m[1].slice(0,3)));if(mi>=0){let y=+m[2];if(y<100)y+=2000;return y+'-'+String(mi+1).padStart(2,'0');}}
 return null;}
function manParseCSV(text){const lines=text.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l=>l.trim());if(lines.length<2)return 0;
 const delim=lines[0].indexOf('\t')>=0?'\t':',';const hdr=lines[0].split(delim).map(h=>h.trim());
 const fmap=hdr.map(manHeaderField);let monthCol=hdr.findIndex(h=>/month|date|period/i.test(h));if(monthCol<0)monthCol=0;

/* distribute each in-period month's SnS totals across that month's days, weighted by the
   day's share of total account sales (DAILY rev). Active subs are point-in-time → held flat
   at the month value. Returns one row per day, oldest→newest. */
function snsDailyEst(monthIdxs){
 const ad=acctDaily(),rows=[];
 monthIdxs.forEach(mi=>{
   const mr=(SNS.rev&&SNS.rev[mi])||0,mu=(SNS.units&&SNS.units[mi])||0,mo=(SNS.oos&&SNS.oos[mi])||0;
   const act=(SNS.active&&SNS.active[mi]!=null)?SNS.active[mi]:null;
   const days=ad.filter(d=>d.mi===mi),tot=days.reduce((a,d)=>a+(d.rev||0),0);
   if(days.length&&tot>0){
     // weight by each day's share of total account sales
     days.forEach(d=>{const w=(d.rev||0)/tot;
       rows.push({date:d.date,label:dayLabel(d.date),mi,rev:mr*w,units:mu*w,oos:mo*w,active:act});});
   } else {
     // no daily sales coverage for this month → spread evenly across calendar days (preserves the month total)
     const ym=IDX2YM[mi]||MO[mi],n=Math.max(1,daysInMonth(ym)),w=1/n;
     for(let dd=1;dd<=n;dd++){const ds=ym+'-'+String(dd).padStart(2,'0');
       rows.push({date:ds,label:dayLabel(ds),mi,rev:mr*w,units:mu*w,oos:mo*w,active:act});}
   }
 });
 return rows;
}
function snsWeeklyEst(monthIdxs){const dr=snsDailyEst(monthIdxs),out=[];
 for(let i=0;i<dr.length;i+=7){const c=dr.slice(i,i+7),s=k=>c.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b[k]||0),0);
   out.push({date:c[0].date,label:'Wk '+dayLabel(c[0].date),rev:s('rev'),units:s('units'),oos:s('oos'),active:c[c.length-1].active});}
 return out;
}
